workflow: ASTM D4172 Four-Ball wear proficiency cycle
blinded participant and sample identities until human disposition
two-replicate control with six wear-scar measurements per run

method.r_R_note: Fixture QC constants from commonly published D4172 precision summaries. Not a copy of the ASTM standard.

acceptance: exactly 48 READY_FOR_HUMAN with exact golden WSD/r/R rounding
zero sample or participant swaps on the frozen fixture
deterministic HOLD for missing replicates or breached QC
immutable custody chain and calculation provenance
human-only CoA release; autonomous release denied
exclusions: adapters remain simulated/read-only until buyer/vendor validation
decision_boundary: proficiency calculation, QC hold, custody, and human CoA disposition receipts only; never live instrument I/O, accreditation claims, or customer release
